rulings.restated: Enter the amount from qbi helper "Taxable income before the QBI deduction; Form 1040 line 11a minus lines 12e and 13b, floored at zero".
rulings.model: IRS line 11 instructions compute 'Form 1040 or 1040-SR, line 11a, minus lines 12e and 13b' and do not provide a zero floor; the restatement adds an 'If zero or less, enter -0-' condition.
rulings.ruling: Ruling: representation; f8995 pp. 3–4: Form 1040 line 11a cannot be negative, so the floor restates the form. Project stands.

rulings.restated: Enter the amount from qbi helper "Add sd.net_gain, f1040.line3a".
rulings.model: IRS line 12 instructions say if you're not required to file Schedule D, your net capital gain is the amount on Form 1040 line 7a; the restatement uses only the smaller of Schedule D lines 15 and 16.
rulings.ruling: Ruling: representation; f8995 pp. 3–4: when no Schedule D is filed, sd.net_gain is Form 1040 line 7a. Project stands.
